title: The Pedestrian Patterns Dataset
reasoning: The paper's core motivation is to create a dataset for risk assessment in autonomous driving to enhance safety. It explicitly discusses using the data to "select the least risky path," "reduce the possibility of harming a child," and analyzes "Risk... for Understanding When to Trust." This focus on risk, safety, and trust in an autonomous system constitutes a significant component of evaluating the ethical behavior of that system, going beyond a mere mention of ethical considerations.
